# Lines carrying their readings, on the course their acts generate

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`readings-carried-on-their-course` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](readings-carried-on-their-course.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A world whose relata act by their carried readings is the course those acts generate; the line read off it is descended by construction and carries its founders' reading; with ending read as that course's overdraw, every occasion picking that reading, G3's realization premise is the identity.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Each relatum exchanges as the act its reading gives. Where every member of a part carries one reading, the world is the rest acting by its readings and the part by that reading's act, by construction. Acts reading what has stood, or only what couples into their relatum, give a world that does too. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.byReading`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsThroughOwn`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.byReading_withAct`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.byReading_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.byReading_through`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ReadsThroughOwn.through_act`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. A balanced flow in which every formation exchanges as a law of what has stood gives, under the flow's own levels, has the levels the law generates at every step, and the law's course is feasible: balance gives the feasibility that the uniqueness of the generated course takes as a premise. (`Becoming.Flow.totals_of_follows`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.levels_of_follows`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.feasible_of_follows`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* balance; its declarations do not reach the grammar, which represents balance and cannot state it without amounts.
3. From founders and a listing of the relata, the line read off a flow takes as a member's offspring across a step the listed relata descending from it then. It is descended in the flow by construction, its later members stand, and where readings are inherited along descent every member of every cohort carries the founders' reading. (`Becoming.Flow.descendsB`, `Becoming.Flow.descendsB_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf`, `Becoming.Flow.mem_lineOf_kids`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_descended`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_stands`, `Becoming.Flow.InheritsReading`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_carries`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Let a reading end where its world's course overdraws a family from a short stock. Where every occasion picks the reading the line carries and the world is the course it generates, G3's realization premise is the identity, ending being defined as that overdraw; under G3's remaining premises some strict order according with the choices puts every non-ending reading above every ending one met with it. (`Becoming.Flow.Overdraws`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_persists_never_overdraws`, `Becoming.Flow.carried_keeping_above_ending`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* balance; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. A line is alive at a step where its cohort then has a member. It reaches a relatum before a step where a member of one of its cohorts, a member at that earlier step, exchanged with a condition the relatum then requires: reach before a step lifted to lines with membership dated, implying the time-blind form for every part holding the members, and lying within affecting. (`Becoming.Flow.LineAlive`, `Becoming.Flow.LineReachesBefore`, `Becoming.Flow.LinesReachBefore`, `Becoming.Flow.LineReachesBefore.reachesBefore`, `Becoming.Flow.LineReachesBefore.affects`, `Becoming.Flow.LinesReachBefore.alive`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. In the witness every course is the one the acts generate, each relatum acts by the reading it carries, readings are inherited along descent and the line carries its reading; the line reaches the dweller's line before the second step by clearing its habitat; with nothing coming back the dweller's line reaches nothing, and in the course where it renews the source it reaches the line. (`Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.generated`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.world_byReading`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.inherits`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.lineA_carries`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.cleared_reaches_dweller`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.lineD_slots`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.cleared_dweller_reaches_nothing`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.clearedBack_dweller_reaches_line`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.cleared_standpoints_late`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* balance; its declarations do not reach the grammar, which represents balance and cannot state it without amounts.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; one kind of relatum, each a formation and a condition; a web, the relata present and the starting levels supplied.
- The act each reading gives is supplied, and so is which relata are listed and which founders start a line.
- Inheritance of readings along descent is a premise of the law that a line carries its founders' reading; the witness proves it of its world.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That an act indexed by what a line carries reads it only within a closure: carrying the index gives nothing of how the act reads it, so ActReadsWithin stays a premise.
- That an ending pick is realized as an overdraw where occasions pick different readings: that needs a run made of the picks, not built here.
- How a reading arises or changes: readings here are carried along descent, never varied or learned.
- That reach before a step by a time-blind part gives a line's dated reach: the lift goes one way. Witness: `Becoming.Flow.LineReachesBefore.reachesBefore`.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Stated for discrete steps.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Pure core, axiom report empty; a leaf. Every law is near-definitional; the witness has finitely many relata, its courses' balance proved for all steps and shown to be the generated ones. Written by an AI; readers of two other models read the statements cold against this record and its home (READER in the study folder); no human audit.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

A run made of the picks, so that occasions choosing different readings are realized on one course; and readings that vary along descent, so that how a reading arises, not only how it fares, is on the model.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Reading (the AI's, from its knowledge): a reading inherited along descent and acted on is a heritable trait with its phenotype, the world acting by it its extended phenotype in the sense of niche construction (Odling-Smee, Laland and Feldman, 2003); the line read off a flow is a lineage of replicators, a self with no member kept.
